headline.caveat: five-year base contract (Sep 2025); rises to $19.4B if Microsoft takes additional services and capacity

realized_to_date.caveat: capacity delivering from Nebius's Vineland, NJ data center; billed amounts not disclosed

nature_md: Five-year, $17.4B dedicated GPU-capacity agreement (announced Sep 8, 2025) — the deal that validated Nebius as a top-tier neocloud, sending its shares up ~50%. Microsoft gets dedicated capacity from Nebius's new Vineland, New Jersey facility as Azure AI demand outruns Microsoft's own buildout; the value can rise to $19.4B with additional services and capacity. Nebius said it would finance the buildout partly with debt secured against the contract — committed hyperscaler revenue converted directly into borrowing capacity.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Committed capacity purchases expensed as consumed (Azure cost of revenue); a purchase commitment in footnotes rather than capex — capacity without owning the asset.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Anchor of Nebius's ~$46B contracted backlog (with Meta's up-to-$27B); explicitly used as collateral for debt financing of the capex program ($16–20B guided for 2026). Single-customer concentration on the realized-revenue side until Meta deliveries begin in 2027.
